resources.string: The Night Owl is known for its ability to see in the dark and its keen senses.
The Reality Rerouter can bend reality to their will, changing the world around them.
Andre the Awesome is endowed with super strength and incredible agility.
Benjamin the Brave possesses uncanny courage and the power of lightning.
Kiran the Quick moves faster than the speed of light, dodging any danger.
Yen the Yodeler can shatter glass and disorient enemies with their powerful voice.
